_comment: Free CUPS driver packages Photosphere can switch on (state.json printing.drivers). Proprietary drivers (Canon UFRII, Brother's own…) stay in site.nix: helios.printing.drivers + unfreeDrivers. Most printers made since ~2015 need none of these: they print driverless (IPP Everywhere / AirPrint).
